## Load Data

```{r}
mobeast <- read_csv(here("data", "MOBEAST_24h.csv"))
mobeast_DNA <- read_csv(here("data", "MOBEAST_DNA_24h.csv"))
```

```{r}
meta <- mobeast %>% select(id_number, tank_number, treatment,
                           inflow_table, date_time, date, time, 
                           flowrate, log_flow) %>% distinct()
mobeast <- mobeast %>% filter(variable_cat == "FCM" | variable_cat == "chla" ) %>% select(id_number, variable, conc_norm)


mobeast_DNA <- mobeast_DNA %>% filter(str_detect(genus_tax, "Syn")|
                         str_detect(genus_tax, "Prochl")) %>% 
  mutate(variable = ifelse(str_detect(genus_tax, "Syn"),
                           "syn_dna", "pro_dna")) %>% 
  select(id_number, variable, conc_norm) %>% distinct()

microbe <- rbind(mobeast, mobeast_DNA)

mobeast_micro <- left_join(meta, microbe) %>% 
  select(id_number, treatment, tank_number, tank_number, time, flowrate, variable, conc_norm) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = variable, values_from = conc_norm) %>% 
  mutate(treatment = factor(treatment, levels = c("Control", "Coral", "CCA", "Algae")))
  
```


## Plots 
```{r}
mobeast_micro %>%  
  mutate(time_fac = factor(time, 
                                 levels = c("12:00:00",
                                            "18:00:00",
                                            "00:00:00",
                                            "06:00:00"))) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x= syn, y= syn_dna, color = treatment))+
  geom_point()+
  geom_smooth(method = "lm")+
  #facet_grid(treatment ~ time_fac)+
  facet_wrap(. ~ treatment)+
  theme_classic()+
  scale_color_manual(breaks = c("Control", "Coral", "CCA", "Algae"), 
                       values=c("grey", "#03A9F4", "#EF5350", "#4CAF50"))
```


## Models 

```{r}
# DNA vs FCM

mod_syn <- lmer(syn_dna ~ syn*treatment + (1|tank_number), data = mobeast_micro)
anova(mod_syn, type= 2) # signficant 

MuMIn::r.squaredGLMM(mod_syn)


mod_pro <- lmer(pro_dna ~ pro*treatment+ (1|tank_number), data = mobeast_micro)
anova(mod_pro, type= 2 ) # significant!

MuMIn::r.squaredGLMM(mod_pro)

# FCM vs chla
mod_syn_chla <- lmer(chla_conc ~ syn*treatment + (1|tank_number), data = mobeast_micro)
anova(mod_syn_chla, type= 2) # not signficant 

mod_pro_chla <- lmer(chla_conc ~ pro*treatment+ (1|tank_number), data = mobeast_micro)
anova(mod_pro_chla) # not signficant 

# DNA vs chla
mod_syn_dna_chla <- lmer(chla_conc ~ syn_dna*treatment+ (1|tank_number), 
                       data = mobeast_micro)
anova(mod_syn_dna_chla, type= 2) # significant 

mod_pro_dna_chla <- lmer(chla_conc ~ pro_dna*treatment+ (1|tank_number), 
                       data = mobeast_micro)
anova(mod_pro_dna_chla, type= 2) # not significant 


```



```{r}
pro_pro_dna_emmeans <- tidy(emmeans(mod_pro, pairwise ~ treatment)$contrasts) %>% 
  mutate(model = "pro vs pro DNA") %>% 
  select(-null.value, -std.error, -df, -term) %>% 
  relocate(model)


syn_syn_dna_emmeans <- tidy(emmeans(mod_syn, pairwise ~ treatment)$contrasts) %>% 
  mutate(model = "syn vs syn DNA") %>% 
  select(-null.value, -std.error, -df, -term) %>% 
  relocate(model)


syn_dna_chla_emmeans <- tidy(emmeans(mod_syn_dna_chla, pairwise ~ treatment)$contrasts) %>% 
  mutate(model = "syn DNA vs chla") %>% 
  select(-null.value, -std.error, -df, -term) %>% 
  relocate(model)

emmeans_results <- rbind(pro_pro_dna_emmeans,syn_syn_dna_emmeans,syn_dna_chla_emmeans)

emmeans_results %>% filter(adj.p.value <0.05)
```

```{r}
cor.test(mobeast_micro$syn, 
         mobeast_micro$syn_dna, 
         method = "pearson")

cor.test(mobeast_micro$pro_dna, 
         mobeast_micro$pro, 
         method = "pearson")

cor.test(mobeast_micro$syn_dna, 
         mobeast_micro$chla_conc, 
         method = "pearson")
```



```{r}
set.seed(120)
mobeast_micro %>%  
  mutate(treatment = factor(treatment, levels = c(
    "Control", "Coral", "CCA", "Algae"))) %>% 
ggplot( aes(x= treatment, y = pro_dna, fill = treatment))+
  geom_boxplot()+
```

```{r}
mobeast_micro %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = pro,
             y = pro_dna,

```

```{r}
mobeast_micro %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = syn_dna,
             y = chla_conc,
             color = treatment,
             group = tank_number)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE,
              aes(group = 1),  # single regression line across all

  facet_wrap(~ treatment)
```


# Thoughts 

Prochlorococcus absolute and relative abundance are linearly correlated. So that translate to an actual increase/decrease in pro in the DNA as opposed a simple change in taxa abundance. But the control vs Algae contrast is not signficant !!! X( 

There is indeed a treatment effect on pro_dna which was already identified in the DNA models.
